items.alt_text: A lone silhouetted person stands inside a stone hall beside a tall blue geometric panel; sunlight casts long shadows across the tiled floor.
An elevated daytime view shows buses and motion-blurred traffic on a roadway beside tree-lined bus stops.
A rider on a rearing white horse is surrounded by a herd of horses on a plain beneath hazy mountains.
Two silhouetted figures walk toward daylight at the end of a rough stone passage.
A close view of a long weathered concrete wall covered with faded graffiti beneath a pale sky.
A shirtless person opens a refrigerator covered with colorful magnets in a kitchen.
A turquoise mountain lake is bordered by evergreen forest and a jagged, snow-dusted mountain range.
A vertical aerial view shows dense buildings and roads meeting a straight edge of rows of palm trees.
A black-and-white photograph shows weathered buildings with arched openings beneath a cloudy sky; ‘NOW IS OUR TIME’ is painted on one wall.
A bare torso emerges from folds of black fabric against a nearly black background.
A person wearing sunglasses reclines nude on an ornate gold chair in a dim room while holding a phone.
A person stands framed by successive arched doorways inside a heavily damaged building.
Black keyboard keys spell NO WHERE TO ESC on a white surface beside a small insect.
A dark fluted circular structure surrounds a small central opening; a rough concrete surface appears at lower right.
Two people lean from the windows of a weathered teal train; one wears a patterned white head covering and the other a bright orange head covering.
At night, a small white building with a red roof stands on a grassy hill under a starry sky; a person stands beside the gate below in the glow of a light.
